people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it known.
translations.bsb: Esther did not reveal her people or her lineage, because Mordecai had instructed her not to do so.
translations.kjv: Esther had not shewed her people nor her kindred: for Mordecai had charged her that she should not shew
